# Pricing results (generated by `src/optimise_prices.py`)

Average store-week. Category = the four chunk light 6 oz brands. Prices limited to the 5th-95th percentile of prices seen in the data. Intervals: 90%, from redrawing the elasticities.

## Baseline

| Brand | Price | Unit cost | Margin | Units |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| StarKist | $0.81 | $0.59 | 28% | 150 |
| Chicken of the Sea | $0.80 | $0.59 | 26% | 90 |
| Bumble Bee | $0.78 | $0.54 | 31% | 79 |
| Dominick's | $0.75 | $0.55 | 27% | 68 |

## Move only the private label price

Category profit change: **+8.9%** (90% interval +7.6% to +10.3%).

| Brand | Baseline price | Recommended price | Price interval | Units change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| StarKist | $0.81 | $0.81 | held | -1% |
| Chicken of the Sea | $0.80 | $0.80 | held | +3% |
| Bumble Bee | $0.78 | $0.78 | held | +4% |
| Dominick's | $0.75 | $0.94 (top of tested range) | $0.94-$0.94 | -24% |

## Move all four prices

Category profit change: **+36.1%** (90% interval +32.0% to +39.7%).

| Brand | Baseline price | Recommended price | Price interval | Units change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| StarKist | $0.81 | $1.03 (top of tested range) | $1.03-$1.03 | -32% |
| Chicken of the Sea | $0.80 | $0.99 (top of tested range) | $0.99-$0.99 | -35% |
| Bumble Bee | $0.78 | $0.99 (top of tested range) | $0.99-$0.99 | -24% |
| Dominick's | $0.75 | $0.94 (top of tested range) | $0.94-$0.94 | -18% |
